rationale: C21 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Issued only one month earlier, it uses the same distinctive multi-carrier formulation naming an initial railroad, referring to other carriers represented by conference committees, and incorporating an attached List A. The child also closely follows C21's complete operative sequence: unresolved Railway Labor Act dispute, National Mediation Board interruption finding, thirty-day board report, and section 10 preservation of conditions. C12 reinforces the attached-list machinery and overlaps substantially with the child's carrier list, while C25 is especially close in identifying the Western Carriers' Conference Committee and the same Switchmen's Union, but neither matches the child's combined language and structure as closely as C21.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Chicago, Rock Island and Pacific Railroad Company and other carriers represented by the Western Carriers' Conference Committee, designated in List A attached hereto and hereby made a part hereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Akron & Barberton Belt Railroad and other carriers represented by the Eastern, Western, and Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committees, designated in List A attached hereto and made a part hereof
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared formulation for identifying a lead carrier, additional represented carriers, and an incorporated list.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the disputes within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly verbatim reporting provision, adjusted only from plural disputes to a singular dispute.

shared_material.child_excerpt: no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Chicago, Rock Island and Pacific Railroad Company or any other carrier represented by the Western Carriers' Conference Committee, or by their employees, in the conditions out of which the dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Akron & Barberton Belt Railroad or any other carrier represented by the Eastern, Western, and Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committees, or by their employees, in the conditions out of which these disputes arose.
shared_material.explanation: The same section 10 operative machinery and sentence structure are adapted to a different carrier group and singular dispute.
